description: Land Acquisition - Ihala Bambawa, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries and extents, making it clearly land-related. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is only in the context of his authority to make land acquisition declarations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is entirely focused on land matters.
